summary: Iteration 3 verified: Hero appointment form replaces doctor image card (all 5 required fields + date picker), server-side validation for source=hero_form, admin Enquiries page date filter + Online Appointments tab + stat cards, TinyMCE WYSIWYG on blog/service/doctor/about/events/offers forms, Website Settings notify_email + reCAPTCHA fields, grouped admin sidebar (Overview/Website Content/Settings) with avatar pill, polished admin login page. Backend: 65/65 pytest passing (20 new tests added). Frontend: verified 5 viewports (1440/1200/1024/768/390) with 0px horizontal overflow, empty submit blocked by HTML5 required, full booking flow end-to-end (form -> DB -> admin listing with village/district/preferred_date -> date filter -> source=hero_form filter).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero form: all 5 fields correctly marked `required` with HTML5 constraint; server-side ContactController enforces required + after_or_equal:today when source=hero_form. Native <input type='date'> used with `min={today}` so past dates blocked at both layers.
Enquiry model saves village, district, preferred_date columns (migration 2026_01_11 ran). Verified via UI end-to-end: submitted booking appears in admin with village/district/date badge.

Admin Enquiries page has 3 stat cards (Total/Online/Received Today), tabs (All / Online Appointments / Contact Form / Today), and a filter form with search + date + status. Date filter ?date=YYYY-MM-DD and source filter ?source=hero_form both work and display info banner.
TinyMCE 6.8.3 loaded from jsdelivr CDN and initialized on all .wysiwyg textareas — iframe.tox-edit-area confirmed on /admin/blogs/create.

Website Settings: notify_email, recaptcha_site_key, recaptcha_secret_key all persist via POST /admin/website-settings. reCAPTCHA is inactive by default (empty keys) so contact form doesn't require captcha token, as designed.
Admin login redesign confirmed via screenshot: gradient mustard->coral M+ logo mark, Fraunces 'Mahaveer CMS' heading, aubergine background — no green anywhere.
Sidebar section labels 'Overview', 'Website Content', 'Settings' render correctly; avatar pill with initial 'A' visible in topbar.
Backend regression: all 10 public pages + all 15 admin listings still return 200. Contact form (source=contact) still saves enquiries.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 20 new tests: hero form fields/required/valid submission/past date rejection, admin enquiries date+source filter, TinyMCE presence on 6 admin content forms, website-settings new fields + save, grouped sidebar, new login design, non-hero contact regression)
